offering_description.value: Designs and sells protective films and coatings for vehicles, such as paint protection film, window film and ceramic coatings, sold mainly to certified installers and automotive businesses that apply them to customers' vehicles.

primary_products.value: paint protection film; window tint film; ceramic coatings; vehicle wraps; installation accessories

primary_services.value: installer training and certification; technical support

customer_segment.value: B2B: independent installers, automotive dealers, fleet operators, body shops; B2C: vehicle owners who buy protection through installers

end_markets.value: automotive aftermarket; automotive dealers; vehicle fleets; consumer vehicles

revenue_model.value: product sales: films, coatings and accessories sold to installers and distributors; service fees: installer training and certification programs

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes films and coatings in its own facilities, sold to installers and distributors; brand owner: markets its own protection products under its brand to installers and vehicle owners

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: paint protection film, window film, ceramic coatings and accessories sold to the same installers

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: regional distributors and independent installer networks; direct sales: national accounts and large fleet customers

regulatory_exposure.value: low: only normal product safety, chemical handling and business rules apply
